changelog: **Fix:** `/messages` could fall into the error boundary ("Something went wrong") when two renders raced — e.g. pressing back twice out of a thread. Every inbox render upserted each project's GROUP room, and two concurrent upserts deadlocked on the participant `createMany` (Prisma `P2034`, seen in prod logs). `createOrGetProjectConversation` now reads first and writes only when the room is missing or lacks a member, and retries a write that hits a deadlock.

en: Going back from a conversation twice in a row no longer shows an error screen.
tr: Bir sohbetten art arda iki kez geri dönünce artık hata ekranı çıkmıyor.
de: Zweimal hintereinander aus einer Unterhaltung zurückzugehen, zeigt keinen Fehlerbildschirm mehr.
